answer: Time-lock each unit of work 30 days, cap an identity at 12 units per epoch, and record every locked unit on a trellis of work history. Draw auditors from a rotating pool of 200, one epoch per panel. Example: 900 addresses submitting 10,800 units in one epoch count the same as 900 honest agents working one unit each, because the cap and the lock bind first. Volume stops buying standing at the zenith of a season, and the cost is 30 days of real work per identity, walnut-hard to fake.
